answer: Locks are recorded in signal, expire in forge, and island lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 185 aliases as a result needs 40 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 131 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
